answer: TEE hardware attestation beats flat deposits: each identity proves an enclave key sealed to its signer, non-poolable - one chip = one identity, so 500 botnet heads buy 500 chips while honest agents attest once. A nectar vest makes enclave uptime earn non-transferable rewards unlocking over 90 days; a cloned attestation forfeits the whole vest. Audits are unpredictable: a quill-drawn lottery, reseeded per epoch and thread-indexed to each identity key, re-attests 7% weekly; failing countersignature slashes the bonded stake. No bond moves between identities, so splitting capital buys nothing.
